earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog sheb1234: extinct; only attestation is a very short wordlist in de Laet 1633 (pp. 642-643); no grammar/phonology exists
earlier_scan.note: Unattestable — 17th-c. wordlist only, no prosodic data possible

sources.citation: de Goeje, C. H. 1939. Nouvel examen des langues des Antilles avec notes sur les langues arawak-maipure et caribes et vocabulaires shebayo et guayana (Guyane). Journal de la Société des Américanistes 31(1): 1-120 (Shebayo: pp. 4-5, 117-118). doi:10.3406/jsa.1939.1984
sources.note: Nothing. pp. 4-5: de Laet gives a short Shebayo vocabulary; analysis places it in Arawak-Maipure but distinct from Aruan, Palikur, Lokono. pp. 117-118: the 15 words re-edited with comparanda; only structural remark is 'La syllabe initiale wa- est probablement le préfixe personnel indiquant la 1re pers. du plur.; la syllabe finale -ly, -ri est peut-être suffixe.'

sources.citation: de Laet, Joannes. 1633. Novus orbis seu Descriptionis Indiae Occidentalis libri XVIII. Lugduni Batavorum: apud Elzevirios. Lib. XVII, cap. XII 'De barbarorum horum idiomate, praesertim Yaiorum', p. 642.
sources.note: Nothing. The whole Shebayo record is a 13-item column 'Shebayis' (Heja, Hamma, Wackewijrrij, Wackenoely, Noeyerii, Wassibaly, Darrymaily, Wadacoely, Watabaye, Wackehyrry, Ataly, Hoerapallii, Hewerry) plus 'Shebaioi Kyrtryrre' (moon) and 'She: Wecoelije' (sun); no accents, no remarks on pronunciation.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page sheb1234 Shebayo (refs: de Laet 1633 pp. 642-643; Ramirez 2020 p. 648; comment 'attested by a very short wordlist', classified Unclassified Wapishanan).
Wikipedia, 'Shebayo language' (cites de Laet 1633, de Goeje 1939, Taylor 1977, Aikhenvald 1999; reproduces the ~15-word list).
Ramirez, Henri. 2020. Enciclopédia das línguas Arawak: acrescida de seis novas línguas e dois bancos de dados. Curitiba: Editora CRV. p. 648.
